facts.fact: Wingu Africa, a carrier-neutral data centre operator, announced on 31 March 2026 the launch of Wingu Cloud Exchange, a private cloud (compute, Kubernetes, storage, security) now available in Ethiopia and keeping customer data in-country; no facility is named.

systems.tiers: operator describes itself as Tier III-standard (East Africa, no Ethiopian facility named)

note: No tier3 fact: Tier III-standard claim is about Wingu's East Africa data centres generally, not a named Ethiopian facility. Service fact is inferred from in-country hosting; weak on facility identity.
